Preorder with bounds. O(n).

For serialize bst preorder I will serialize preorder and deserialize by bounds.

```python
def serialize(root):
    out = []
    def walk(n):
        if not n: out.append('N'); return
        out.append(str(n.val))
        walk(n.left); walk(n.right)
    walk(root); return ','.join(out)
```
